import z3

# Parameters
n_golfers = 32
n_weeks = 7
group_size = 4
n_groups = 8

# Create variables: x[w][p] = group of golfer p in week w (0..7)
x = [[z3.Int(f'x_{w}_{p}') for p in range(n_golfers)] for w in range(n_weeks)]

solver = z3.Solver()

# Domain constraints: each x[w][p] in 0..7
for w in range(n_weeks):
    for p in range(n_golfers):
        solver.add(x[w][p] >= 0, x[w][p] < n_groups)

# Each week: each group has exactly 4 golfers
for w in range(n_weeks):
    for g in range(n_groups):
        # Count how many golfers are in group g in week w
        # Use z3.PbEq (pseudo-boolean equality)
        solver.add(z3.PbEq([(x[w][p] == g, 1) for p in range(n_golfers)], group_size))

# No pair of golfers appears together more than once
# For each pair (p1, p2) with p1 < p2, at most one week where they share a group
for p1 in range(n_golfers):
    for p2 in range(p1 + 1, n_golfers):
        # At most one week where x[w][p1] == x[w][p2]
        solver.add(z3.PbLe([(x[w][p1] == x[w][p2], 1) for w in range(n_weeks)], 1))

print("Solving...")
result = solver.check()
print(result)
if result == z3.sat:
